purpose: Table-level structural truth for the row/grid audit: which tables the engine got right, and what it got wrong on the ones it didn't. Every label was established without running the audit, so the harness measures it rather than confirming it.
method: Positive labels come from the source page's own text (pdftotext / pypdfium2 reading of the region) compared against the emitted grid: a value printed on the page and absent from every cell is a loss whoever reports it. Negative labels come from agreeing row counts between two independent line-finding mechanisms - pypdfium2's native text_lines over the table region and the engine's own cell rows - plus reading the emitted grid. Tables where the two mechanisms disagreed for reasons not yet run down are left unlabelled rather than guessed.
